svg.title: Runtime workload protocol
svg.desc: Each cell records excluded warmups, every task and command latency, task success, matched socket and CLI control calls, physical-footprint samples, process membership and observed CPU. The sampler uses bench/memory.py responsibility-disclaimed launch and macOS responsibility attribution to include daemon plus responsible WebKit/GPU/network processes. Physical footprint is not RSS. Sample processing itself costs time, recorded as samplerDurationMs; the nominal sampling wait is 250 ms, and actual timestamp spacing includes sampler work. Fast process creation/exit between samples can escape peak and CPU observations. The fixture server and Python harness are excluded from browser-family memory/CPU. Raw timestamps make this limitation inspectable.
